title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-daily-homework-self-test PR #216 review
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #216 (backend-daily-homework-self-test), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: docs/architecture/Backend.md §7's persistence table enumeration (the sentence listing positions/account/watchlist/ohlcv_cache) doesn't mention the new daily_homework_entries table -- update it, and while there, note it's already missing closed_trades/extended_data_cache too (a pre-existing staleness this PR's own omission continues; see commit 5d5b86d which filed an identical follow-up for watchlist_items previously).

_today()/_utcnow() naive-UTC helper functions are now duplicated a 4th time (app/api/routers/portfolio.py, app/api/routers/watchlist.py, app/api/routers/homework.py, app/data/cache.py) with near-identical docstrings cross-referencing each other -- consider consolidating into one shared module (e.g. app/api/time_utils.py or similar) rather than continuing to copy-paste it into every new router.

Found during PR #216's re-review (backend-daily-homework-self-test): after the _today()/_utcnow() consolidation into app/time_utils.py, two integration test files still have local test-only _today() helpers whose docstrings say 'Matches app.api.routers.portfolio._today() exactly' -- that function no longer exists (moved/renamed to app.time_utils.today()). The test helpers themselves are self-contained and still correct, this is purely a stale docstring cross-reference. Update the docstrings in backend/tests/integration/test_portfolio_delete_position.py (around line 32) and backend/tests/integration/test_portfolio_risk.py (around line 36) to reference app.time_utils.today() instead.

decisions.decision: Both follow-up items implemented directly on PR #216's branch (task/backend-daily-homework-self-test) rather than on a separate branch/PR for this -followups task, while addressing that PR's blocking review finding in the same area. Consolidated the four duplicated _today()/_utcnow() helpers into a new app/time_utils.py (today()/utcnow(), module-level, no leading underscore since it's now a shared public helper) imported by app/data/cache.py and app/api/routers/{portfolio,watchlist,homework}.py; updated docs/architecture/Backend.md §7's persistence-table sentence to list closed_trades, extended_data_cache, and daily_homework_entries alongside the tables already named.
decisions.rationale: The task dispatch for backend-daily-homework-self-test explicitly authorized folding these two non-blocking items into the same PR 'if convenient while in this area', and both touch exactly the files already being edited for the float-equality fix -- opening a second PR for a few lines of docs/import consolidation would be pure process overhead. Left this task's own state as 'planned' rather than moving it to 'done' myself: that transition is normally driven by task-qa-reviewer/pr-reviewer verifying the claim, and this task has no git.pr_number of its own to point at (the work landed via PR #216, not a dedicated PR for this id) -- a human/reviewer can confirm and close it out once PR #216 merges, rather than this task-worker self-certifying its own follow-up task as done with no independent check.

decisions.decision: Verified PR #216 is merged to main (commit 45c54bb) and that checklist items 1 and 2 are already live on main: docs/architecture/Backend.md §7 lists closed trades, extended data cache, and the daily homework entries table alongside the pre-existing tables, and backend/app/time_utils.py exists with today()/utcnow() consumed by app/data/cache.py and app/api/routers/{portfolio,watchlist,homework}.py. No further action was needed for those two items beyond this verification. Fixed the third (only remaining open) item: updated the stale '`app.api.routers.portfolio._today()`' docstring cross-references in backend/tests/integration/test_portfolio_delete_position.py and backend/tests/integration/test_portfolio_risk.py to point at `app.time_utils.today()` instead. Ran both affected test files (51 passed) and ruff on both files (clean) to confirm the docstring-only change didn't affect behavior.
decisions.rationale: The task description explicitly asked for verification of items 1/2 plus the docstring fix for item 3; no alternative approach was needed since this was a pure documentation/comment correction with no behavioral ambiguity.
